verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a built-in AI assistant inside Jeeves that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server is for external AI assistants and agents working "without opening the Jeeves app," so it does not count as a built-in assistant. Smart invoice scanning and automated receipt emails are automation features, not an assistant you can delegate to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
